item.title: Pedestrian walkway closed at Gananoque's Confederation Park
item.description: The pedestrian walkway at Confederation Park has been temporarily closed due to elevated water levels, according to the Town of Gananoque. Town officials say the closure will remain in place until water levels recede and the area can be safely reopened to the public.
